title: Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung | Modern Man in Search of a Soul)
summary: Three-hour philosophy stream reading chapter 2 of Jung's Modern Man in Search of a Soul (the four stages of analytical psychology: confession, explanation, education, transformation), with constant parallels to fitness influencers, incels, male emotional repression and self-improvement. The last hour is an open Q&A on philosophy, manga, money, therapy, lifting and his life.
claims: Self-improvement often starts in the gym because the body is ridiculously easy to change, and once you change it you realize you can change everything else in life
Elitism is good: high standards create excellent people, low standards create garbage people
Many men aged 20 to 40 feel alone and are actively looking for friendships, so friends can be found if you seek those men out
Politics has very little real impact on your daily life; believing it does makes it so, and you can choose to be happy every day
For a long mentally taxing session like a 3-hour stream, keep a quick caloric source at hand such as dark chocolate or applesauce
House-invasion dreams are mostly a male phenomenon: a biological instinct preparing the man who is on the front line of defending the home
Jung earns trust by opening his book with the problems of psychotherapy, a sign of intellectual honesty
Many competing schools of psychoanalysis are like 15 apple pie recipes: different valid methods, not proof that all are wrong; you must adapt the method to your particularities
Fitness has rival schools for hypertrophy and strength that never agree, which confuses the audience; the best fitness creators share common ground with others because they reached it independently
Do not treat his channel as the only answer: look around, because someone else might have the answer you need
He deliberately avoids giving clear-cut answers because developing the ability to find the answer is what makes you better, not the answer itself
The rise of psychology, astrology and occultism over the last 100-200 years fills the vacuum left by the decline of religion in the West
Like psychoanalysis with its pseudo-scientific jargon, many fitness people make training hyper complex on purpose to obfuscate and position themselves as prophets
Having private secrets individuates you, while secrets shared by a group (taboos, virtues, myths) build culture; a private secret that is too severe isolates you
The idea of sin as a moral experience predates religion by roughly 10,000 years; religion built on it to create a value system
Unconscious repressions roam freely as part of the Shadow and surface in dreams when conscious control relaxes, which is why shadow work matters
The unconscious is not a garbage can for the conscious; it is not inherently negative
A fully conscious or fully unconscious person is mentally ill; the psyche needs both in balance
If you have suicidal ideation, talk about it with others: speaking takes away its power, while censorship and euphemisms like unalive push it into the unconscious where it is dangerous
Emotional concealment is the number one reason men are not doing well today
Self-discipline is one of humanity's earliest moral attainments and a reason we became the apex species; a cat given 15 days of food eats it in 3
Men and women feel the same amount of emotion; men repress more, which makes them more stoic but becomes harmful when they bury emotions that hurt them
The cure for male loneliness is accepting your own emotions; people who call lonely men big babies participate in repressing male emotion
Unspoken jealousy or resentment toward friends or family festers until it explodes and kills the relationship; speak about it early
Psychoanalysis is essentially confession without the church
If you have faith or are willing to develop it, join a church, mosque or synagogue; religious viewers should cling to their religion even though he is not religious
Talking about problems without actionable steps is just spiraling; a therapist who lets you ramble for hours without giving steps is a charlatan
Nietzsche was not anti-religious; many viewers told him his Nietzsche and Christianity videos brought them closer to God
Confession cannot be done alone: its purpose is making yourself vulnerable before others, since the problems that isolate you can only be cured by rejoining humanity
The incel mentality is resentment where there should be gratitude; resentment cuts you off from the group and breeds more resentment
Some highly rational people are so cut off from their unconscious they cannot reach it, like a novice who never lifted and has terrible mind-muscle connection with his own body

Followers often become emotionally dependent on fitness influencers who become their new dad; many influencers avoid explaining so they keep a quasi-supernatural fascination over young men, whereas he tries to always explain
Many psychoanalysts feed transference so the patient stays bound to them and pays indefinitely
Humans are part angel, part demon; Jung's shadow and Nietzsche's genealogy of morals are aligned in tracing lofty institutions to crude origins
Berserk is a feminist story: showing the plight of women from the shadow side is necessary to explain and change it, not an apology for it
Walking in the forest with friends and talking over a cigar is a healthy male ritual giving social interaction and a form of confession
He reread Modern Man in Search of a Soul six or seven times over three years before lecturing on it
A good educator succeeds even with people who lack the value being taught; if all your successes already had it, you are not really teaching
Incels crave society's acceptance and importance (Adler's will to power), not pleasure; saying they are like this because they do not get laid is wrong
People who feel rejected by society and cannot fit in should read Adler

Modern self-improvement culture is Adlerian: 99% of it is replacing bad habits with good ones, but habits rooted in neurosis will not yield to that alone, and gurus wrongly blame you for not wanting it enough
Thinkers' egos get attached to their ideas; in philosophy and fitness alike we should focus on the similarities among competent people instead of differences
Becoming normal means becoming mediocre; his channel is transformative and aims for you to become what you are, above normal
Society sells a checklist of marriage, kids, car and good job, and many who tick it feel dead inside; it is healthy to figure out an abnormal life if that is what fulfills you
A good teacher is a perpetual student and a good student is a future teacher; both are transformed by the relationship
He does not take hypertrophy advice from small people: an educator must possess the quality he professes to teach
Parents teach by example: tell kids nothing but go to the gym and run every day and they will become active; preach activity from the couch and they become couch potatoes
Bodybuilders get called vain for sharpening body and mind, while hours of social media or TV are not called self-absorption; people avoid self-examination out of fear of what they will find
He only helps people in his commercial gym if they approach him first; only educate those who want to be educated
Jung is rejected by academic psychology because he said human quality matters more than diplomas, that analysis can be done outside the clinic, and he opposed replacing it with pills
When choosing a therapist, pick one who will not immediately put you on pills, does real analytical examination, educates you and avoids transference and authority power
Self-improvement gurus impose a rigid checklist of masculinity, and many of them are not masculine in their own daily lives
Cut off narcissistic people, even close family; there is no dealing with them
After six months porn-free the hardest part is done; just stay away from it
Planning every day of your life gives it value but can make you hyper rigid
Start philosophy with stoicism as an introduction before Nietzsche
In grad school he lived on about $700 a month but always had a room, bed and food
He is making Ko-fi his main income, offering program and physique reviews to donors
He refuses to make a Discord because it creates parasocial communities waiting for the owner as a savior
Asking a teacher for proof of ability before taking advice is not egoistic
Transhumanism is escapism; we should fully optimize our current biology and psyche before technological enhancement
Growth requires asymmetric friendships: hang out with people better than you who extend a hand, and help those below you
When he got buff at 16-17 and girls noticed his arms, most of his male friends resented him
AI will not replace doctors because people seek human reassurance, not just a diagnosis
If you are tired, rest: being tired means you have been productive too long
Earn enough to pay bills, save and live comfortably; pursuing more money only fills a spiritual void
To remember dreams, keep a dream journal next to your bed and write on waking
He has no cheat meals because he does not eat clean; cheat meals imply punishing yourself all week
His marriage is more important to him than bodybuilding
Losing all his gains would be hard, but he knows he could build them back
A strong manual laborer doing judo twice a week who wants to start lifting should train 2x/week, 45 minutes, 2 compound movements and 3 isolations
Paused bench press is better than touch-and-go
Some men grow muscles for the wrong reasons, like bullies seeking power, but they rarely last because the group rejects them
Gaining 1.5 lb a month on a lean bulk is good: very slow, but progress can still be tracked
Constantly listening to music is a sign of overstimulation and avoiding your own thoughts
His bodybuilding goals have not changed with age; he never cared about being lean and still does not
He never wants to get shredded: outside of photos you are hungry, unfocused, weaker and smaller
Psychedelics can serve ritual or therapeutic purposes (depression, PTSD) but most use them to escape reality
He never believed in God; at catechism he treated the Bible as teachings about himself rather than faith
Any self-improvement that tells you to buy something (car, watch) to become more of a man is a scam; take the spiritual route
Someone fit and strong but more depressed than ever spent effort in the wrong direction and needs to focus on the spiritual
Most people are skinny or fat because both result from lack of physical activity and discipline
Lifting gloves are fine if eczema leaves no choice
His 10-year goals: homeschool his kids, buy a house, not depend on a corporation, and get bigger
He refuses to monetize the channel so view counts never push him away from philosophy content
He keeps his services cheap for accessibility: physique review $10, French lessons $35 an hour
viewer_questions: advice for someone unhappy with life
why not just join the church
does talking about bad thoughts keep them alive
why people are skinny or fat
